Operator.title: Operator
Operator.description: Represents a cleaning operator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Operator entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the cleaning operator.

lastName.description: The last name of the cleaning operator.

visibleInLogin.description: Determines if the operator is visible in the login dropdown.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator within the WorkForce Hub application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Admin entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the administrator.

lastName.description: The last name of the administrator.

userId.description: The ID of the user who made the clocking event.

timestamp.description: The exact date and time of the clocking event.

latitude.description: The latitude of the location where the event occurred.

longitude.description: The longitude of the location where the event occurred.

status.description: The approval status of the clocking event.

Request.title: Request
Request.description: Represents a user request for leave, overtime, etc.

userId.description: The ID of the user making the request.

startDate.description: The start date/time of the request.

endDate.description: The end date/time of the request.

hours.description: The number of hours requested (for 'permesso' or 'straordinario').

reason.description: An optional reason for the request.

definition.description: Stores information about all users (admins and operators).

params.name: userId

params.name: adminId

firestore.reasoning: The data structure has been simplified to only include user and role management, as all other features have been removed per the user's request. A 'Timbratura' entity and collection have been added to support clock-in/out functionality. Firebase Auth has been removed and a 'password' field added to user entities for a simple code-based login.
